verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation's official docs list search, dark mode, performance mode, app installs, etc., but never mention window snapping/tiling layouts. The only tiling-related community comment (fedora-comm-5) praises 'native window tiling' in the Fedora 39 KDE Spin, a separate product variant, not the GNOME-based Workstation being evaluated, so it cannot count as evidence for this product.
